<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const API_KEY = "us2-61f41b8a4f501a41901cf46e7710c5d3";
    const getSignedInState = async () => {
      const url = "https://gateway.gofundme.com/web-gateway/v1/feed/identity";
      return fetch(url, {
          method: "GET",
          mode: "cors",
          credentials: "include",
        })
        .then((response) => response.json())
        .then((data) => {
          if (data?.references?.identity && data.references.identity.length > 0) {
            return {
              identity: data.references.identity[0],
              isLoggedIn: true,
            };
          }
          return {
            isLoggedIn: false,
          };
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          console.error("Fetch error:", error);
          return {
            isLoggedIn: false,
          };
        });
    };

    const loadMParticleScript = (apiKey) => {
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const f = document.createElement("script");
        f.type = "text/javascript";
        f.async = true;
        f.src = `https://jssdkcdn.mparticle.com/js/v2/${apiKey}/mparticle.js?env=${window.mParticle.config.isDevelopmentMode ? 1 : 0}`;
        f.onload = resolve; // Resolve the promise when the script is loaded
        const p = document.getElementsByTagName("script")[0];
        p.parentNode.insertBefore(f, p);

    };

    const loadMParticle = (userIdentities) => new Promise(async (resolve) => {
      const mpDomain = "mp-data.gofundme.com";
      window.mParticle = {
        config: {
          isDevelopmentMode: false,
          dataPlan: {
            planId: "web_client_native_mobile_apps_data_plan",
          },
          ...(userIdentities ? {

          v1SecureServiceUrl: `${mpDomain}/webevents/v1/JS/`,
          v2SecureServiceUrl: `${mpDomain}/webevents/v2/JS/`,
          v3SecureServiceUrl: `${mpDomain}/webevents/v3/JS/`,
          configUrl: `${mpDomain}/tags/JS/v2/`,
          identityUrl: `${mpDomain}/identity/v1/`,
          aliasUrl: `${mpDomain}/webevents/v1/identity/`,
          onCreateBatch: (batch) => {
            // set the batch timestamp to undefined so that mParticle will set this time on the server
            batch.timestamp_unixtime_ms = undefined;
            return batch;
          },
        },
      };

      // Use the new loadMParticleScript function here
      await loadMParticleScript(API_KEY);

      mParticle.ready(() => resolve());
    });

    //load the SDK
    (function(e) {
      window.mParticle = window.mParticle || {};
      window.mParticle.EventType = {
        Unknown: 0,
        Navigation: 1,
        Location: 2,
        Search: 3,
        Transaction: 4,
        UserContent: 5,
        UserPreference: 6,
        Social: 7,
        Other: 8
      };
      window.mParticle.eCommerce = {
        Cart: {}
      };
      window.mParticle.Identity = {};
      window.mParticle.config = window.mParticle.config || {};
      window.mParticle.config.rq = [];
      window.mParticle.config.snippetVersion = 2.3;
      window.mParticle.ready = function(e) {
        window.mParticle.config.rq.push(e)
      };
      var i = ["endSession", "logError", "logBaseEvent", "logEvent", "logForm", "logLink", "logPageView", "setSessionAttribute", "setAppName", "setAppVersion", "setOptOut", "setPosition", "startNewSession", "startTrackingLocation", "stopTrackingLocation"];
      var n = ["setCurrencyCode", "logCheckout"];
      var t = ["identify", "login", "logout", "modify"];
      i.forEach(function(e) {
        window.mParticle[e] = o(e)
      });
      n.forEach(function(e) {
        window.mParticle.eCommerce[e] = o(e, "eCommerce")
      });
      t.forEach(function(e) {
        window.mParticle.Identity[e] = o(e, "Identity")
      });

      function o(i, n) {
        return function() {
          if (n) {
            i = n + "." + i
          }
          var e = Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments);
          e.unshift(i);
          window.mParticle.config.rq.push(e)
        }
      }
      var r, c, a = window.mParticle.config,
        s = a.isDevelopmentMode ? 1 : 0,
        l = "?env=" + s,
        w = window.mParticle.config.dataPlan;
      if (w) {
        r = w.planId;
        c = w.planVersion;
        if (r) {
          if (c && (c < 1 || c > 1e3)) {
            c = null
          }
          l += "&plan_id=" + r + (c ? "&plan_version=" + c : "")
        }
      }
      var d = window.mParticle.config.versions;
      var m = [];
      if (d) {
        Object.keys(d).forEach(function(e) {
          m.push(e + "=" + d[e])
        })
      }
      var f = document.createElement("script");
      f.type = "text/javascript";
      f.async = true;
      f.src = ("https:" == document.location.protocol ? "https://jssdkcdns" : "http://jssdkcdn") + ".mparticle.com/js/v2/" + e + "/mparticle.js" + l + "&" + m.join("&");
      var p = document.getElementsByTagName("script")[0];
      p.parentNode.insertBefore(f, p)
    })(API_KEY);

    const createGDPRConsent = (mParticle, consent) =>
      mParticle.Consent.createGDPRConsent(consent, Date.now(), "", "", "");

    const createCCPAConsent = (mParticle, consent) =>
      mParticle.Consent.createCCPAConsent(!consent, Date.now(), "", "", ""); // This is inverted between Transcend and mParticle (so true means opted out in this case)

    const getNewConsentState = (mParticle, consent) => {
      const newConsent = mParticle.Consent.createConsentState();
      newConsent.addGDPRConsentState("advertising", createGDPRConsent(mParticle, consent.Advertising));
      newConsent.addGDPRConsentState("analytics", createGDPRConsent(mParticle, consent.Analytics));
      newConsent.addGDPRConsentState("functional", createGDPRConsent(mParticle, consent.Functional));
      newConsent.setCCPAConsentState(createCCPAConsent(mParticle, consent.SaleOfInfo)); // CCPA (true means opted OUT)
      return newConsent;
    };

    const syncUserConsent = async () => {

      try {
        const mParticleUser = window.mParticle.Identity.getCurrentUser();
        if (!mParticleUser) {
          return;
        }

        await window.airgap.sync();
        const {
          purposes
        } = window.airgap.getConsent();
        const keys = Object.keys(purposes);
        const values = Object.values(purposes);

        /*  Transcend allows for different defaults on a regional basis. If there is a disallowed consent
            purpose, its default value will come through as `false` and if there is NOT, its value comes
            through as "Auto" rather than `true`. mParticle expects a boolean value for each purpose, so
            we need to convert the "Auto" values to `true` for syncing.
            See Transcend: https://app.transcend.io/consent-manager/regional-experiences */
        if (values.includes("Auto")) {
          keys.forEach((key) => {
            if (purposes[key] === "Auto") {
              purposes[key] = true;
            }
          });
        }
        const current = mParticleUser.getConsentState();
        const ccpa = current?.getCCPAConsentState();
        const gdpr = current?.getGDPRConsentState();
        const hasAlreadySyncedConsent =
          ccpa &&
          gdpr &&
          purposes.SaleOfInfo === !ccpa.Consented &&
          purposes.Advertising === gdpr.advertising.Consented &&
          purposes.Analytics === gdpr.analytics.Consented &&
          purposes.Functional === gdpr.functional.Consented;

        if (hasAlreadySyncedConsent) {
          return;
        }
        const newConsent = getNewConsentState(mParticle, purposes);

        mParticleUser.setConsentState(newConsent);

      } catch (e) {
        console.error("ANALYTICS: Failed to sync consent", e);
      }

    };

    const handleConsentChange = ({
      detail: {
        consent: {
          purposes
        },
        changes,
      },
    }) => {
      const mParticleUser = window.mParticle.Identity.getCurrentUser();
      if (!mParticleUser || !changes) {
        return;
      }
      /*  Now that we have data-sync="off" on our Transcend script we shouldn't see any consent-change
          events except those triggered by the user where the values should never be set to "Auto". */
      if (Object.values(changes || {}).includes("Auto")) {
        console.error("ANALYTICS: Tried to change to default consent values", changes);
        return;
      }

      // Fully clear previous consent state
      const previousConsentState = mParticleUser.getConsentState();
      if (previousConsentState) {
        previousConsentState.removeCCPAConsentState();
        previousConsentState.removeGDPRConsentState("advertising");
        previousConsentState.removeGDPRConsentState("analytics");
        previousConsentState.removeGDPRConsentState("functional");
      }

      // Set new consent state
      const newConsent = getNewConsentState(mParticle, {
        Advertising: !!(changes.Advertising ?? purposes.Advertising),
        Analytics: !!(changes.Analytics ?? purposes.Analytics),
        Functional: !!(changes.Functional ?? purposes.Functional),
        SaleOfInfo: !!(changes.SaleOfInfo ?? purposes.SaleOfInfo),
      });

      mParticleUser.setConsentState(newConsent);
      window.mParticle.logEvent("Consent Changed", mParticle.EventType.UserPreference, withGlobalProps(), withGlobalFlags());

    };

    const withGlobalProps = (original = {}, isLoggedIn) => {
      const info = {
        ...original,
        platform_source: "wordpress client",
        logged_in_state: isLoggedIn ? "logged in" : "logged out",
        mp_device_id: window.mParticle.getDeviceId(),
      };
      const {
        searchParams
      } = new URL(window.location.href);
      ["campaign", "content", "medium", "source", "term"].forEach((key) => {
        const param = `utm_${key}`;
        if (searchParams.has(param)) {
          const name = key === "campaign" ? "name" : key;
          info[`campaign_${name}`] = searchParams.get(param);
        }
      });
      if (searchParams.has("attribution_id")) {
        info.attribution_id = searchParams.get("attribution_id");
      }
      return info;
    }

    const withGlobalFlags = (original = {}) => {
      const flags = {
        ...original,
        "GA4.Title": document.title,
        "GA4.Location": window.location.href,
      };
      return flags;
    }

    const bindLinkClicked = (isLoggedIn) => {
      const handleClick = (event) => {
        const link = (event.target)?.closest("a");
        if (!link) {
          return;
        }

        const tracking_id = link.getAttribute("data-tracking-id");
        const placement = link.getAttribute("data-placement");
        let linkPathname = '';
        try {
          const pathname = new URL(link.href, window.location.href).pathname;
          linkPathname = pathname === '/' ? '/' : pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '');
        } catch (error) {
          linkPathname = '';
        }
        const isFundraiserCreateCTA = linkPathname === '/create' || linkPathname.startsWith('/create/');

        const customAttributes = withGlobalProps({
            outbound: !new URL(link.href).origin.includes("gofundme.com"),
            link_url: link.href,
            page_url: window.location.href,
            text: link.textContent || link.getAttribute("aria-label") || "Missing accessible text",
            ...(tracking_id ? {
              tracking_id
            } : {}),
          },
          isLoggedIn,
        );
        const customAttributesFundraiser = withGlobalProps({
            link_url: link.href,
            text: link.textContent || link.getAttribute("aria-label") || "Missing accessible text",
            ...(tracking_id ? {
              tracking_id
            } : {}),
            ...(placement ? {
              placement
            } : {}),
          },
          isLoggedIn,
        );
        const customFlags = withGlobalFlags();

        window.mParticle.logEvent("Link Clicked", window.mParticle.EventType.Navigation, customAttributes, customFlags);

        if (isFundraiserCreateCTA) {
          window.mParticle.logEvent("Fundraiser Create CTA Clicked", window.mParticle.EventType.Navigation, customAttributesFundraiser, customFlags);
        }
      };

      document.body.addEventListener("click", handleClick, {
        capture: true
      });
    };

    const trackPageView = (isLoggedIn) => {
      mParticle.logPageView(
        "Page",
        withGlobalProps({
          page_referrer: document.referrer,
          page_title: document.title,
          page_url: window.location.href
        }, isLoggedIn),
        withGlobalFlags()
      );
    };

    const init = async () => {
      const {
        isLoggedIn,
        identity
      } = await getSignedInState();

      await loadMParticle(identity ? {
        email: identity.email,
        customerid: identity.person_id.toString()
      } : undefined);

      mParticle.ready(async () => {
        await syncUserConsent();
        setTimeout(() => window.airgap?.addEventListener("consent-change", handleConsentChange), 100);
        trackPageView(isLoggedIn);
        bindLinkClicked(isLoggedIn);
      });
    };

    init();
  });
</script>

/* CU-868k7zknw: pin the header to the top of the viewport on scroll, at all
   breakpoints, matching prod Product pages — consumer/marketing pages were
   missing this and the nav scrolled away.
   position:fixed rather than sticky: sticky's "stuck" range is bounded by
   its containing block's own box height, and on some templates (e.g.
   /c/blog) <body>'s layout box is capped well short of the page's true
   scrollable height (content overflows it visibly), so sticky runs out of
   room part-way down the page and the header scrolls away permanently.
   fixed has no such dependency — it's always anchored to the viewport.
   The .hrt-header-sticky-wrapper div is a JS-sized spacer (see script below)
   that reserves the header's height in the flow so content doesn't jump
   underneath it.
   This rule targets .hrt-header--default directly, NOT the shipped
   .hrt-header--fixed modifier — that class is intentionally absent from the
   <header> markup below. main-min.css's .hrt-header--fixed{position:fixed}
   should have been usable as-is, but a legacy stylesheet
   (dist/styles/main.css, the pre-Heart-migration pipeline) also defines
   .hrt-header{position:relative} with no --fixed equivalent, and loads
   AFTER main-min.css in <head> — same specificity, later origin wins, so it
   silently defeats --fixed every time, which is exactly why that class went
   unused before this fix. !important guarantees this rule wins regardless
   of stylesheet load order, current or future. */
.hrt-header--default {
    position: fixed !important;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    z-index: 900;
}
/* CU-868k7zknw: the fixed header now overlays whatever sits at viewport
   top:0, including the "Skip to content" link's target (#skipnav, rendered
   in base.php right after this header). Without this, activating that link
   scrolls #skipnav under the fixed header, hiding the landing point for
   keyboard/screen-reader users. --gfm-header-height is kept in sync with
   the header's real height by the resize-spacer script below. */

   (position:fixed + z-index:900 above), so .mobile-modal-container's
   z-index:9999999 only wins against siblings INSIDE <header> — it can

   <body> (root stacking context) at z-index:1100 when the menu opens.
   That backdrop was rendering on top of the entire header, including the
   open mobile menu, blocking every tap. Lift the header above it, but only
   while the menu is open, so this doesn't affect any other overlay/modal
   on the site. */

        const diffInMinutes = Math.floor(diffInSeconds / 60);
        const diffInHours = Math.floor(diffInMinutes / 60);
        const diffInDays = Math.floor(diffInHours / 24);

                created: 'Recaudación de fondos creada'

            'es_US': {

        };

        // Fallback to 'en_US' if locale is not defined
        const translation = translations[locale] || translations['en_US'];

        // Helper function to select singular or plural
        const pluralize = (count, singular, plural) => count === 1 ? singular : plural;

        // Determine the format based on the time difference
        let formattedTime;
        if (diffInDays >= 1) {
            const dayLabel = Array.isArray(translation.day) ?
                pluralize(diffInDays, translation.day[0], translation.day[1]) :
                translation.day + (diffInDays > 1 ? translation.plural : '');

            formattedTime = (locale.startsWith('en')) ?
                `${translation.created} ${diffInDays} ${dayLabel} ${translation.ago}` :
                `${translation.created} ${translation.ago} ${diffInDays} ${dayLabel}`;
        } else if (diffInHours >= 1) {
            const hourLabel = Array.isArray(translation.hour) ?
                pluralize(diffInHours, translation.hour[0], translation.hour[1]) :

                `${translation.created} ${diffInHours} ${hourLabel} ${translation.ago}` :
                `${translation.created} ${translation.ago} ${diffInHours} ${hourLabel}`;

                pluralize(diffInMinutes, translation.minute[0], translation.minute[1]) :

                `${translation.created} ${diffInMinutes} ${minuteLabel} ${translation.ago}` :
                `${translation.created} ${translation.ago} ${diffInMinutes} ${minuteLabel}`;
        }

        return formattedTime;

  // Phase 2 of the signed-in mobile menu refactor (see PR #2614). Fired only

  //   .gfm-signed-in-start-giving-fund  ← when viewer has no Giving Funds

  //   .gfm-signed-in-charity-dashboard  ← when the logged-in user has a

  // Schema mirrors ssr-frontend's useDonorDonations / useHasGivingFund /
  // useCharityUserData hooks (see apps/next-app/src/shared/hooks/*).
  function revealSignedInNavState() {
    const graphqlBody = JSON.stringify({
      query: [
        'query SignedInNavState {',
        '  viewer {',
        '    id',
        '    givingFunds { id }',
        // CU-868k7xdhq restore: mirrors ssr-frontend's useDonorDonations(pageSize: 1) —
        // gates the "Donations you've made" row on donations.edges.length > 0.
        '    donations(last: 1) { edges { node { id } } }',

        // Mirrors ssr-frontend's AvailableProfiles query exactly.
        '    availableProfiles {',
        '      id',
        '      name',
        '      image',
        '      actor { id actor { __typename ... on User { id } ... on Charity { id } } }',
        '    }',
        // CU-868hpkz7w: chatUserId signals the user has the messaging hub —
        // used to reveal the Messages row (ssr gates it on the hub experiment).
        '    personChatDetails { chatUserId }',
        '  }',
        '  getCharityForLoggedInUser {',
        '    charity { slug country }',
        '    isLegacyClaim',
        '  }',
        '}',
      ].join('\n'),
    });
    fetch("https://graphql.gofundme.com/graphql", {
      headers: {
        "accept": "*/*",
        "accept-language": "en",
        "client-name": "Wordpress",
        "client-version": "1.0.0",
        "content-type": "application/json",
      },
      credentials: "include",
      method: "POST",
      mode: "cors",
      body: graphqlBody,
    })

      const viewer = data && data.data && data.data.viewer;
      const charityData = data && data.data && data.data.getCharityForLoggedInUser;

      // Giving Fund vs Start your Giving Fund — alternative rows.
      const givingFunds = (viewer && viewer.givingFunds) || [];
      if (givingFunds.length === 0) {

        jQuery('.gfm-signed-in-start-giving-fund').show();
      }

      // Donations you've made — reveal only when the donor has made 1+ donations.
      const donationEdges = (viewer && viewer.donations && viewer.donations.edges) || [];
      if (donationEdges.length > 0) {
        jQuery('.gfm-signed-in-donations-made').show();

      // Charity dashboard — label + href mirror ssr's getCharityNavHref:
      // a modern US claim (isUSCustomer && isLegacyClaim === false) routes to
      // GoFundMe Pro (the Classy admin); everyone else keeps the per-charity
      // dashboard link. PRO_ADMIN_URL is env-aware (prod vs staging Classy).
      const charitySlug = charityData && charityData.charity && charityData.charity.slug;
      if (charitySlug) {
        const charityCountry = charityData.charity && charityData.charity.country;
        const isUSCustomer = charityCountry === 'US';
        const isModernClaim = isUSCustomer && charityData.isLegacyClaim === false;
        const proAdminUrl = /(^|\.)gofundme\.com$/.test(location.hostname)
          ? 'https://classy.org/admin'
          : 'https://staging.classy-test.org/admin';
        if (isModernClaim) {
          jQuery('.gfm-signed-in-charity-dashboard a').attr('href', proAdminUrl);
          jQuery('.gfm-signed-in-charity-dashboard .hrt-base-list-item-title').text('GoFundMe Pro');
        } else {
          const charityHref = '/charity/' + encodeURIComponent(charitySlug) + '/dashboard';
          jQuery('.gfm-signed-in-charity-dashboard a').attr('href', charityHref);
        }
        jQuery('.gfm-signed-in-charity-dashboard').show();
      }

      // Messages reveal — ssr gates this on the messaging-hub experiment. We
      // don't have that flag in WP, so use chatUserId (the user has a chat
      // identity) as the proxy: present => the hub is available for this user.
      const chatUserId = viewer && viewer.personChatDetails && viewer.personChatDetails.chatUserId;
      if (chatUserId) {
        jQuery('.gfm-signed-in-messages').show();
      }

      // CU-868hpkz7w NPO profile switcher — gate + render. Mirrors ssr's
      // shouldShowProfileSwitcherNavBlock (availableProfiles.length > 1 OR a
      // non-User profile exists). Single-User accounts never see the switcher.
      const availableProfiles = (viewer && viewer.availableProfiles) || [];
      const hasNonUserProfile = availableProfiles.some(function (p) {
        const typename = p && p.actor && p.actor.actor && p.actor.actor.__typename;
        return typename && typename !== 'User';
      });
      if (availableProfiles.length > 1 || hasNonUserProfile) {
        renderProfileSwitcher(availableProfiles);
      }
    })
    .catch(error => {
      console.error('Signed-in nav state error:', error);
    });
  }

  // CU-868hpkz7w: parse the selected_profile cookie the same way ssr-frontend's
  // parse-selected-profile.ts does (URL-decode then JSON-parse; require a
  // string profileId). On WP /c/ this cookie is usually absent — it's written
  // by ssr's switcher on other domains — in which case selected defaults to the
  // user's own profile. Returns null when missing/invalid.
  function parseSelectedProfileCookie() {
    const match = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)selected_profile=([^;]+)/);
    if (!match) return null;
    try {
      const obj = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(match[1]));
      if (!obj || typeof obj.profileId !== 'string' || !obj.profileId) return null;
      return obj;
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  // CU-868hpkz7w: reveal + populate the profile-switcher nav block (desktop +
  // mobile). Mirrors ssr-frontend's ProfileSwitcherNavBlock: identity header +
  // (when multi-profile) a "Switch profile" row showing the NEXT unselected
  // profile, followed by a divider. The "Switch profile" button opens the modal
  // picker (gfmOpenSwitcherModal) which writes the selected_profile cookie.
  function renderProfileSwitcher(profiles) {
    const selected = parseSelectedProfileCookie();
    // Own user = the User-typed profile; the default-selected when no cookie.
    const ownUser = profiles.find(function (p) {
      return p && p.actor && p.actor.actor && p.actor.actor.__typename === 'User';
    });
    const selectedId = (selected && selected.profileId) || (ownUser && ownUser.id) || null;
    // Next unselected profile (ssr: first whose id !== selected, else first).
    const next = profiles.length > 1
      ? (profiles.find(function (p) { return p.id !== selectedId; }) || profiles[0])
      : null;

    // Selected identity for the panel header (charity uses the logo avatar style).
    const selectedObj = profiles.find(function (p) { return p.id === selectedId; }) || ownUser || profiles[0];
    const selName = (selected && selected.profileName)
      || (selectedObj && selectedObj.name) || '';
    const selImg = (selected && selected.profileImage)
      || (selectedObj && selectedObj.image) || '';
    const selectedTypename = selectedObj && selectedObj.actor && selectedObj.actor.actor
      && selectedObj.actor.actor.__typename;
    const selIsCharity = ((selected && selected.actorType) || selectedTypename) === 'Charity';

    // Desktop panel header (avatar-left). Populate selected identity.
    if (selName) {
      jQuery('.gfm-ps-desktop-name').text(selName);
      // Dropdown trigger button shows the full selected-profile name (ssr's
      // buttonTitle = selectedProfile.profileName), not just the first name.
      jQuery('.first-name').text(selName);
    }
    if (selImg) {
      jQuery('.gfm-ps-desktop-avatar-img').attr('src', selImg).show();
      jQuery('.gfm-ps-desktop-avatar-default').hide();
    }
    jQuery('.gfm-ps-desktop-avatar').toggleClass('hrt-avatar--logo', selIsCharity);

    // "Switch profile" row — next profile avatar only (ssr nav block shows the
    // avatar + chevron, no name text). Desktop + mobile share these classes.
    if (next) {
      const nextIsCharity = next.actor && next.actor.actor && next.actor.actor.__typename === 'Charity';
      if (next.image) {
        jQuery('.gfm-ps-next-avatar-img').attr('src', next.image).attr('alt', next.name || '').show();
        jQuery('.gfm-ps-next-avatar-default').hide();
      }
      jQuery('.gfm-ps-next-avatar').toggleClass('hrt-avatar--logo', !!nextIsCharity);
    }

    // Ternary swap (ssr): show the switcher block, hide the plain Profile row.
    jQuery('.gfm-account-profile-row').hide();
    jQuery('.gfm-profile-switcher-block').css('display', '');

    // Widen the desktop dropdown so the full name fits on one line. The panel
    // is right-anchored, so the extra width grows LEFT (toward the logo) while
    // the right edge stays put against the container (ssr profileNavBlock width).
    jQuery('.gfm-ps-desktop-name').closest('.hrt-header-dropdown-content').addClass('gfm-ps-dropdown-wide');

    // Stash the profile list + current selection for the switch-profile modal,
    // then wire the (desktop + mobile) "Switch profile" buttons to open it.
    window.gfmPSData = { profiles: profiles, selectedId: selectedId };
    jQuery('.gfm-ps-switch-btn').off('click.gfmps').on('click.gfmps', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      gfmOpenSwitcherModal();
    });
  }

  // CU-868hpkz7w: build + open the switch-profile picker (ssr Modal + ProfileSwitcher
  // parity). Lists every available profile; selecting a non-current one writes the
  // selected_profile cookie and full-refreshes so all surfaces pick up the new actor.
  function gfmOpenSwitcherModal() {
    const data = window.gfmPSData || { profiles: [], selectedId: null };
    const $list = jQuery('.gfm-ps-modal-list').empty();
    data.profiles.forEach(function (p) {
      const isSelected = p.id === data.selectedId;
      const inner = p.actor && p.actor.actor;
      const isCharity = inner && inner.__typename === 'Charity';

      const $btn = jQuery('<button type="button" class="gfm-ps-modal-item"></button>');
      if (isSelected) { $btn.addClass('is-selected'); }

      const $av = jQuery('<span class="gfm-ps-modal-avatar hrt-image-avatar hrt-avatar"></span>');
      if (isCharity) { $av.addClass('hrt-avatar--logo'); }
      if (p.image) {
        jQuery('<img class="gfm-ps-modal-avatar-img">').attr('src', p.image).attr('alt', p.name || '').appendTo($av);
      } else {
        $av.addClass('gfm-ps-modal-avatar--initial').text((p.name || '?').charAt(0).toUpperCase());
      }
      $btn.append($av);

      jQuery('<span class="gfm-ps-modal-name"></span>').text(p.name || '').appendTo($btn);

      if (isSelected) {
        $btn.append(
          '<svg class="gfm-ps-modal-check" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">' +
          '<path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5" stroke="#018567" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>'
        );
      }

      $btn.on('click', function () {
        if (isSelected) { return; }
        // Loading state on the clicked row, then switch.
        $btn.addClass('is-switching');
        gfmSwitchToProfile(p);
      });

      jQuery('<li></li>').append($btn).appendTo($list);
    });
    gfmShowSwitcherModal();
  }

  function gfmShowSwitcherModal() {
    jQuery('.gfm-ps-modal-overlay').css('display', 'flex');
    jQuery('body').addClass('gfm-ps-modal-open');
    jQuery('.gfm-ps-modal-close').trigger('focus');
  }

  function gfmCloseSwitcherModal() {
    jQuery('.gfm-ps-modal-overlay').hide();
    jQuery('body').removeClass('gfm-ps-modal-open');
  }

  // Write the selected_profile cookie (ssr setSelectedProfileCookie shape) then
  // full-refresh. Cookie: name selected_profile, value = URL-encoded JSON, Path=/,
  // session. Mirrors mapAvailableProfileToSelectedProfile.
  function gfmSwitchToProfile(p) {
    const inner = p.actor && p.actor.actor;
    const actorType = inner && (inner.__typename === 'User' || inner.__typename === 'Charity')
      ? inner.__typename
      : null;
    const obj = {
      profileId: p.id,
      actorId: (p.actor && p.actor.id) || null,
      actorType: actorType,
      ownerEntityId: actorType ? ((inner && inner.id) || null) : null,
      profileImage: p.image || null,
      profileName: p.name || null
    };
    document.cookie = 'selected_profile=' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(obj)) + '; path=/';
    window.location.reload();
  }

  // Close interactions (backdrop click, close button, Escape) — bound once.
  jQuery(function () {
    jQuery('.gfm-ps-modal-close').on('click', gfmCloseSwitcherModal);
    jQuery('.gfm-ps-modal-overlay').on('click', function (e) {
      if (e.target === this) { gfmCloseSwitcherModal(); }
    });
    jQuery(document).on('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' || e.keyCode === 27) { gfmCloseSwitcherModal(); }
    });
  });

  function getFundraisers() {
    fetch("https://api.gofundme.com/co/v1/funds", {

        method: "GET",
        mode: "cors",
        credentials: "include",
        cache: "no-store"
    })
    .then(response => response.json())
    .then(fundraisers => {
        if (!Array.isArray(fundraisers) || fundraisers.length === 0) return;

        // Remove deleted/inactive fundraisers
        fundraisers = fundraisers.filter(f => f && f.status !== 0);

        if (fundraisers.length === 0) {
            console.log("No active fundraisers available.");
            return;
        }

        // CU-868hw6w4r #11: viewer has >=1 active fundraiser — reveal the "Your fundraisers"
        // row (desktop + mobile). It is display:none by default to match prod, which omits it
        // for users with no fundraisers.
        jQuery('.gfm-signed-in-your-fundraisers').show();

        // Sort newest first
        fundraisers.sort(function (a, b) {
            var ad = new Date((a && a.created_at) || 0);
            var bd = new Date((b && b.created_at) || 0);
            return bd - ad;
        });

        // create single UL
        const ulElement = document.createElement('ul');
        ulElement.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Manage your fundraisers');
        ulElement.classList.add('hrt-mb-half');
        ulElement.style.listStyle = "none";
        ulElement.style.padding = "0";
        ulElement.style.margin = "0";

        var limit = Math.min(2, fundraisers.length); // show max 2
        for (var i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
            var f = fundraisers[i];
            if (!f) continue;


            var fundraiserUrl = f.url;
            var fundraiserName = (f.fundname && String(f.fundname).trim().length) ? f.fundname : "Untitled";

            // Handle image with fallback
            var image = f.campaign_image_scaled && f.campaign_image_scaled['1x1-960']
                ? f.campaign_image_scaled['1x1-960']
                : f.campaign_image_url || "";

            // Replace default GFM stock image (including CDN proxied versions) with placeholder
            if (!image || image.includes("funds.gofundme.com/css/search/images/gfm_138.jpg")) {
                image = "https://www.gofundme.com/_next/static/images/recent-activity-funds-placeholder-023fd2343e633a50d312b92693d4445ce4a79dad84d837fb64697e2a5d31c669.png";
            }

            var createdAt = f.created_at;
            var timeoutStart = f.timeout_start;
            var isPublished = !!timeoutStart;

            // LI element
            const innerLiElement = document.createElement('li');
            innerLiElement.classList.add('hrt-header-manage-fundraiser-container');
            innerLiElement.style.display = "flex";
            innerLiElement.style.alignItems = "flex-start";
            innerLiElement.style.gap = "12px";
            innerLiElement.style.width = "100%";
            innerLiElement.style.cursor = "pointer";
            innerLiElement.style.padding = "6px 0";

            innerLiElement.addEventListener('click', () => {
                window.location.href = 'https://www.gofundme.com/f/' + fundraiserUrl;

            });

            // image container
            const imageContainerDiv = document.createElement('div');
            imageContainerDiv.classList.add('hrt-header-manage-fundraiser-image-container');

            const imgElement = document.createElement('img');
            imgElement.setAttribute('alt', '');
            imgElement.classList.add('hrt-header-manage-fundraiser-image');
            imgElement.setAttribute('src', image);
            imgElement.style.width = "40px";
            imgElement.style.height = "40px";
            imgElement.style.objectFit = "cover";
            imgElement.style.borderRadius = "4px";
            imageContainerDiv.appendChild(imgElement);

            // text container
            const textContainer = document.createElement('div');
            textContainer.style.display = "flex";
            textContainer.style.flexDirection = "column";

            // fundraiser title
            const titleSpan = document.createElement('span');
            titleSpan.classList.add(
                'hrt-header-manage-fundraiser-title',
                'hrt-text',
                'hrt-text-neutral-800',
                'hrt-text-body-sm'
            );
            titleSpan.textContent = fundraiserName;

            // fundraiser status
            const statusSpan = document.createElement('span');
            statusSpan.classList.add(
                'hrt-header-manage-fundraiser-status',
                'hrt-text',
                'hrt-text-neutral-500',
                'hrt-text-body-sm'
            );
            statusSpan.textContent = isPublished
                ? formatDateTime(createdAt, 'en_US')
                : 'Draft';

            textContainer.appendChild(titleSpan);
            textContainer.appendChild(statusSpan);

            // assemble LI
            innerLiElement.appendChild(imageContainerDiv);
            innerLiElement.appendChild(textContainer);
            ulElement.appendChild(innerLiElement);
        }

        // finally append UL to container
        var activeFundraisers = document.getElementById('active-fundraisers');
        if (activeFundraisers) activeFundraisers.appendChild(ulElement);
    })
    .catch(console.log);
}
